review.notes: Full re-review. Both findings and all corrections and notes of the previous review are repaired. All 15 sampled targets and every headline were recomputed numerically from the Lean definitions (d <= 6, generic and degenerate angles, out-of-range indices), with negative controls; no failure. Suggested.lean elaborates at the pins with 71 sorry warnings and nothing else; one-tactic probe on all 71 sorried theorems closes none. Dependency check: 0 problems. 12 DLMF locators read and agree; the six books (Edmonds, Vilenkin-Klimyk, Klimyk-Vilenkin, Wawrzynczyk, Dieudonne, Miller) could not be read legally and are listed as not verifiable and for the human reviewers. One automatic form check (a section comment heading only #check lines) set aside as a false positive. Small corrections: the Peter-Weyl route sentence of 3.4 (conjugate), a redundant hypothesis in the second zonal theorem, two consumed sections missing from the consumer list.
